content.title: 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets | Club SI Hospitality
content.text: 2-Day Kentucky Derby Ticket Package Available Friday & Saturday Your Kentucky Derby Seating Enjoy unparalleled views of the Churchill Downs Paddock. Club SI: 1st-Floor Paddock Reserved Indoor Table Seating Individual Seat or Full Table for 6 or 8 Covered *All pricing is per person, purchases must be made in singular seats or a group of six or eight for a full table. Upgrade Options: Row J Table of 2 is available as an upgrade in the purchasing dropdown below. View On Map » Club SI Hospitality Exclusive Access Churchill Downs' recently constructed, luxurious venue and premium dining space is located on the 1st-Floor Paddock area and offers a full-service experience. The indoor and climate-controlled space, Club SI, offers a behind-the-scenes view of the Paddock and Paddock Runway. Gourmet Chef's Table Food Buffets New in 2026, guests will enjoy an enhanced selection of gourmet food offerings, with two chef-curated food menus served day and night. Indulge in a wide variety of elevated appetizers, mains, desserts and more, throughout both Oaks & Derby Days. View Sample Menu » Wine & Bourbon Tastings Enjoy first come, first serve tastings of wine and bourbon flights. Premium Open Bar Enjoy Mint Juleps, Oaks Lilys, top-shelf liquor, beer, wine, soft drinks & coffee. Dedicated Club Mutuel Windows Place bets at mutuel windows conveniently located inside the venue. Private Club Restrooms Avoid long lines with access to fine, private restrooms with concierge inside the Club. Add Accommodation & Transfers Enhance your Derby experience with a 3-night stay at one of our partnered hotels and convenient daily round-trip transfers to and from Churchill Downs. 3-Night Accommodations Check-in: Thursday, April 30th Check-out: Sunday, May 3rd Daily Ground Transfers Transportation to/from Churchill Downs and hotel is included with all accommodation purchases through Derby Experiences.
